name: Pangasinan Puzzle Party 2025
information:
This is the 2nd installment of Pangasinan Puzzle Party 2025!

Quick Details:

Registration Fee: Php 400 (good for 4 events). Please see [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PangasinanPuzzleParty2025#58706-payment-details) for more info.
